name: issue-radar
description: Triages a repository's open issues through your local gh or glab: suggests labels from the repository's own label set and ranks the queue by which issues need a maintainer first. Investigation notes stay on your machine, and nothing is ever labeled, commented on or closed on the tracker.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Where label suggestions come from
x-meta.help: model — one isolated model call per issue, constrained to the repository's own labels. plan — emit one brief per issue for your agent to spawn a real subagent from, each reporting via record_investigation. rules — the conservative deterministic pass only, no model.

x-meta.label: Issues per sweep
x-meta.help: How many open issues one sweep reads and triages. A triage_issues call can override it per sweep.

x-meta.label: Stale after
x-meta.help: Days without an update before an issue scores as gone quiet.

x-meta.label: Concurrent per-issue label calls
x-meta.help: How many issues are labeled at once in the model pass.

x-meta.label: Model entry
x-meta.help: Which configured model runs the per-issue label calls. Empty uses the first chat-capable provider from Settings → Models.

x-meta.label: Tracker CLI Timeout
x-meta.help: Maximum seconds to wait for `gh` or `glab` before giving up.
